title: Red Wine Onion Quiche
subtitle: like French onion soup in a tart
description: A quiche filled with onions slowly caramelised with red wine and thyme, set in a creamy custard in a buttery crust. The pastry needs an hour of chilling first.

steps.text: Make the pastry: in a mixer with the paddle attachment, combine 180 g flour, the sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and the cold diced butter into a crumbly mixture. Add the cold water and mix until combined. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour.

Roll the dough out on a floured surface to about 3 mm thick, press it into the base and sides of a tart tin to form a right angle, trim the excess, prick the base with a fork and place in the freezer.

Heat olive oil in a heavy-based pot and cook the sliced onions, stirring occasionally, for about 1 hour until they begin to caramelise. Add the thyme, a pinch of salt, pepper and the wine, stir and cook for another 10 minutes. Cool to room temperature.
Whisk the cream, eggs, 30 g flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper until smooth.

Spread the onion filling in the frozen tart shell and pour the custard over in a circular motion. If you like, scatter breadcrumbs, top with sliced onion and brush with a little olive oil. Bake for 30-40 minutes until nicely browned. Crumble feta over after baking if you like.
